reader.requirement: At 1985, after an unsuccessful I-O operation (no AT END phrase taking precedence) the USE procedure that names the file runs; otherwise the OUTPUT (or EXTEND) procedure runs for a file open, or being opened, in output (or extend) mode, except a file named by file-name-1 in another USE of the same condition; a file in neither situation (e.g. CLOSE of an unopened file) runs no mode procedure.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel >= 2002 adds the SORT GR17 ProgramReturn exit filter around the EC-free __RunUse; 1985 takes the bare try/finally

reader.edition-search: UseTierEmitter has no edition test (its remarks record the edition-invariance as a determination, kb/Work PB344); grepped DispatchEmitter, UseTierEmitter, EcEmitter, SequentialIoEmitter and FileConnector for DialectLevel, CobolVersion, Edition, DialectBehavior, ConstructRegistry: only EmitRunUseBody's GR17 filter, which does not change which procedure is selected.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the file-name tier then open-mode tier selection is the same code at 1985 and 2023; w1 and p6 print identically at --std 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf26_09 covers file-name over mode, OUTPUT and EXTEND during an OPEN on report files; not exercised there: non-report organizations under the same mode procedure, a non-OPEN statement on a file already open OUTPUT, a file in no open mode, the INVALID KEY phrase precedence

probes.expected: GR5 a, b, c: named file runs its own procedure, OUTPUT/EXTEND procedure for files being opened in those modes

probes.printed: CLOSE-C 42 (no procedure); USE-OUTPUT on second OPEN OUTPUT of an INDEXED file (41); WRITE with INVALID KEY phrase -> INVALID-KEY-PHRASE, no procedure; WRITE without phrase, status 22 on a file open OUTPUT -> USE-OUTPUT; OPEN EXTEND of a sequential file already open EXTEND -> USE-EXTEND (41), not USE-OUTPUT
probes.expected: GR5 b/c reach any file open or being opened in the mode, of any organization (SR5); a file not open in output or extend mode reaches neither

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.8.4 GR5  (4.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: Selection is UseTierEmitter's file-name switch then a switch on the connector's OpenModeView, which answers with the mode an OPEN is establishing, so 'in the process of being opened' is covered. The ERROR/EXCEPTION synonym (p5b uses ERROR) and the mixed organizations behave as the rule says.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.4.8.4 GR5 b/c and FileConnector.OpenModeView (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/FileConnector.cs: `_statementMode is { } scoped ? (int)scoped : ModeKnown ? (int)Mode : -1`; BeginOpen sets _statementMode to the mode being ATTEMPTED even when the file is already open in another mode). So an OPEN INPUT or OPEN I-O of a file already open OUTPUT (status 41) reports INPUT/I-O to UseTierEmitter.EmitScopeTiers and the OUTPUT procedure is skipped, although GR5b makes it applicable 'for any file open in the output mode or in the process of being opened in the output mode'. Probe refute-1985-154/u1.cob --std 85 (runs/u1-001): OPEN-S1 00 / OPEN-S2-INPUT-WHILE-OPEN-OUTPUT 41 / OPEN-S3-IO-WHILE-OPEN-OUTPUT 41 (no USE-OUTPUT line for either) / USE-OUTPUT S=47 / READ-S4 47 / OPEN-G1 00 / OPEN-G2-INPUT-WHILE-OPEN-EXTEND 41 (no USE-EXTEND). Only OUTPUT and EXTEND procedures are declared, so no other procedure competes. u2.cob (runs/u2-001), the same in a program with a report file and the Report Writer USE format: OPEN INPUT of the sequential file open OUTPUT -> 41 and no procedure, while a second OPEN OUTPUT of the report file -> USE-OUTPUT. --std 2023 (runs/u1-002): identical output. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.8.4 GR5  (4.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5'. The reader's p5b only tried a second OPEN in the SAME mode, where the attempted and current modes coincide.
edition-sites-missed: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/FileConnector.cs#OpenModeView: no edition switch; the attempted mode replaces the current open mode for every edition
src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/FileConnector.cs#BeginOpen: records the attempted mode before the 41 refusal (the kb/Work PB5200 fix)
refuter.corrected: NON-CONFORMING (wrong-answer, silent), cause b: the same at --std 2023. Repro u1.cob: OPEN OUTPUT SQ-F, then OPEN INPUT SQ-F with only USE ... ON OUTPUT declared; expected the OUTPUT procedure to run on the 41 (the file is open in output mode, GR5b), observed no procedure. Likewise OPEN INPUT of a file open EXTEND runs no EXTEND procedure (GR5c). The PB5200 fix (kb/Work/PB5200/2026-11-10-refuter-85.md) made the being-opened mode win outright, so the 'file open in the mode' half of GR5 b/c is lost whenever the attempted mode differs; when the attempted mode's procedure is absent the current mode's procedure must still run (which of two to run when both are declared is a reading the text leaves open). Known note: PB5200, the arm its fix introduced; no note covers this case.
